# NYC.gov - Official Website of the City of New York

> > Official website of New York City government under Mayor Zohran Mamdani, providing access to city services, news, and information for NYC residents.

NYC.gov serves as the central digital gateway to New York City government, featuring the Mayor's Office, city agencies, and essential services. The site provides news updates, contact information, and resources for residents across all five boroughs including the Bronx, Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, and Staten Island.

## Key Topics

- New York City
- NYC Mayor's Office
- Zohran Kwame Mamdani
- City Government
- Gracie Mansion
- NYPD
- Jessica S. Tisch
- Early Childhood Education
- Housing Enforcement
- Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)
- Disability Services
- Press Releases
- Astoria
- 36th New York State Assembly District
- Reasonable Accommodation

## Mayor's Office

- [Official Site of NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani - NYC Mayor's Office](https://www.nyc.gov/mayors-office): Homepage for NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani with news and press releases

## Contact & Support

- [Contact the Mayor - NYC Mayor's Office](https://www.nyc.gov/mayors-office/contact-the-mayor): Contact form for Mayor Mamdani, media contacts, and FOIL requests

## Optional

- [Mayor's Office Accessibility Statement - NYC Mayor's Office](https://www.nyc.gov/mayors-office/mayors-office-accessibility): ADA compliance and accessibility statement for Mayor's Office website
